name: Dakila: A Gift of Life
source: The story focuses on Dakila, who seem to be an ordinary lad but something happened and he tried to cope with it. Only leaning on his books, will he solve his problems by reading? Or will he be the main character in the books he's reading?
translation: 故事聚焦达基拉。他看似普通，却遭遇某件事，努力应对。他只能依靠书本；通过阅读，他能解决自己的问题吗？还是会成为所读书籍中的主人公？
